title: Run your first 1:1 with your manager
why_matters: The DA's job is partly the SQL and largely the judgement around the SQL. Your manager will be assessing the second more than the first — and your first 1:1 is where you start learning what kind of judgement she values. DAs whose manager-1:1 cadence is weekly come into their probation review with a clear read on their reviewer; DAs without it have to guess.
steps: Book a recurring weekly 30-minute 1:1 if one doesn't exist. Insist on weekly; DAs without it discover they needed it after a finding lands badly.

Draft a one-page agenda. Three sections: 'what I'm noticing about the team's data + dashboards in week 1' (observations only); 'questions I have about how things are decided here'; 'what would help me from you'.

Ask the calibration question: 'when I disagree with a stakeholder about what the data says — say, a counter-intuitive finding for the COO — what would you want me to do before I go into that conversation?'. The answer tells you her appetite for you holding the position alone versus calibrating with her first.
Listen more than you talk. The most useful DAs in their first 1:1 learn what their manager wants them to spend their time on; the least useful ones over-share their planned dashboard projects.
success_criteria: Meeting happened, recurring slot is in both calendars, you walked out with one concrete sentence on what kind of finding your manager wants you to bring to her before presenting elsewhere.
reflection_prompt: What surprised you in your manager's answer to the counter-intuitive-finding calibration question? Two sentences.
